sources.title: UDFA Kolbe Katsis is a speedy WR/KR who could make some noise this summer
sources.description: At the conclusion of the 2026 NFL Draft, the Denver Broncos signed several undrafted free agents, including the speedy Northern Arizona wide receiver, Kolbe Katsis. He is a 6-1, 185-pound wide receiver/returner who will be competing for a spot on the Broncos’ 53-man roster and, more realistically, a spot on their practice squad. During his […]
